title: Kirby's Return to Dream Land turns 15 (Wii, NA 24 Oct 2011)
why: 15 years today in North America; a family series with Arab fans; gap fill for Saturday evening.

sources.name: Nintendo US store page, Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe (nsuid 70010000058797), trailers
Wikipedia: Kirby's Return to Dream Land (dates; 'first traditional Kirby platforming home console game since Kirby 64', uncited there); Nintendo Life feature 24 Oct 2026 '15 Years Ago'

claims.text: Released on Wii in North America on 24 Oct 2011 (JP 27 Oct, EU 25 Nov)
First traditional Kirby platformer on a home console since Kirby 64 (2000); Epic Yarn (2010) is not counted as traditional

drafts.threads:
في مثل هذا اليوم قبل 15 عامًا، صدرت Kirby's Return to Dream Land على Wii في أمريكا الشمالية.

المصدر: نينتيندو
drafts.instagram:
تكمل Kirby's Return to Dream Land اليوم 15 عامًا على صدورها.

صدرت اللعبة على جهاز Wii في أمريكا الشمالية يوم 24 أكتوبر 2011، وكانت أول مغامرة منصات تقليدية لسلسلة Kirby على جهاز منزلي منذ Kirby 64 عام 2000، ويلعبها حتى أربعة لاعبين معًا.

وعادت يوم 24 فبراير 2023 بنسخة Deluxe على Nintendo Switch من شركة نينتيندو (Nintendo).

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #Kirby #Nintendo

notes: Brief: anniversary (في مثل هذا اليوم), template trailer, recipe: fun/oddity close to family 9; hook Kirby's face full frame (48.0 s of the Deluxe overview trailer) then the Ultra Sword, under «مغامرة Kirby على Wii / تكمل 15 عامًا» (iconic character first). Lines on gameplay: release date, first traditional platformer since 2000, four players (the four-character ice level), Deluxe return over Magoland and the key art. 20.2 s. Sound: the overview trailer's own music from 4.0 s, no speech (speechcheck). Footage: Nintendo's 720p (only official copy; lowres_ok), stand-in credit «لقطات من نسخة Deluxe» throughout. Sensitive: none.
Nintendo's store page lists Dream Buffet trailers first (nsuid 70010000056620); the game's own are under 70010000058797. First three downloads were Dream Buffet and were deleted.

v1 line 2 said first platformer since 2000; Kirby's Epic Yarn (Wii, 2010) is a platformer, so v2 says «تقليدية» as the source does. Sales figures left out (only through Wikipedia, Nintendo IR not opened).

Runs 1 and 2 stopped at the runner's text check: «صدرت Kirby's Return to Dream Land» ran out of the safe zone even at 56 px. v2 line 1 drops 'Kirby's' (the headline names Kirby); lines set at 50 to 60 px.
